raw.query: SELECT l.run_id, l.window_name, l.p99_ms, b.bound_ms, (l.p99_ms>b.bound_ms) AS misses_bound, l.fabric FROM (SELECT run_id, window_name, p99_ms, CASE WHEN run_id LIKE '%__g100' THEN 'g100' WHEN run_id LIKE '%__g25' THEN 'g25' END AS fabric FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current=true AND sla_metric='encoder_delay' AND run_id LIKE 'g6:u672%' AND window_name IN ('steady24h','burst3','burst4','burst5')) l, provenance.v_sla_bound b WHERE b.sla_metric='encoder_delay' ORDER BY l.window_name, l.fabric, l.run_id;
raw.observed: steady24h @g100: fcAware=842.492 PASS, static_C8=842.492 PASS, fc_L30=1927.455 FAIL, fc_L30_cap28=1943.981 FAIL. steady24h @g25: ALL four policies miss (fcAware=1012.432, fc_L30=1972.454, fc_L30_cap28=1976.051, static_C8=1012.432). Burst3/4/5 @g100: fcAware/fc_L30=938.734 (-6.1% margin, PASS), fc_L30_cap28=816-851 (PASS), static_C8=2272-3414 FAIL.
raw.evidence: Unqualified '672^2 misses the bound on both fabrics on steady24h' is contradicted by fcAware and static_C8 passing at 842.492 ms on the faster fabric (g100); only the fc_L30 / fc_L30_cap28 forecast policies miss on both fabrics. The audit's CORRECTION 5 wording ('the forecast arm at 672 px FAILS on both fabrics') correctly qualifies the policy; the claim does not.
